# ScriptTasks

[API index](../index.md)

Defines and controls the script runtime's HTN-arbitrated task registrations.

**@keywords**

task, htn, scheduling, automation, priority

## Define

```typescript
Define(Name: string, Priority: HtnPriority, CanStart: () => boolean, Run: (scripttaskcontext: ScriptTaskContext) => void | PromiseLike<void>): ScriptTaskHandle;
```

Registers one named task whose body starts only after `CanStart` passes and HTN admits it.
CanStart is synchronous and read-only: no input, timers, waits, task mutations, or fetch.
Duplicate names and `HtnPriority.NoActive` are rejected by the runtime.

**@keywords**

task, define, htn, scheduling, priority

## CancelAll

```typescript
CancelAll(Reason?: string | null): void;
```

Cancels every task owned by this script runtime without affecting native or other runtimes.

**@keywords**

task, cancel, cleanup, runtime, automation
